description: Header file defining interfaces for Bluetooth audio source functionality, including data structures, callback types, and external function declarations.

methods.name: bluetoothaudiosource_register_operational_state_update_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for operational state updates.

methods.name: bluetoothaudiosource_unregister_operational_state_update_callback
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered operational state update callback.

methods.name: bluetoothaudiosource_register_state_changed_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for state change notifications.

methods.name: bluetoothaudiosource_unregister_state_changed_callback
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered state change callback.

methods.name: bluetoothaudiosource_set_sink
methods.description: Sets the sink callbacks for audio data handling.

methods.name: bluetoothaudiosource_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the Bluetooth audio source.

methods.name: bluetoothaudiosource_get_time
methods.description: Gets the current playback time in milliseconds.

methods.name: bluetoothaudiosource_relinquish
methods.description: Relinquishes control of the audio source.

methods.name: bluetoothaudiosource_dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the audio source resources.
